p: Baale of Judah: This was a city in Judah called also Kirjathjearim, Jos 15:9.
Gibeah: which was a high place in the city of Baale.
played before the LORD on all: Praised God, and sang Psalms.
smote him there for his error: Here we see the danger it is to follow good intentions, or to do anything in God's service without his express word.
the Gittite: Who was a Levite, and had dwelt in Gittaim, 1Ch 15:21.
brought up the ark of God: Meaning, he caused the Levites to bear it according to the law.
ephod: With a garment like the priest's garment.
despised him in her heart: The worldlings are not able to comprehend the emotions that move the children of God to praise God in all kinds of ways.
bless his household: That is, to pray for his house, as he had done for the people.
It was before the LORD: It was for no worldly affection, but only for that zeal that I bore to God's glory.
no child unto the day of: Which was a punishment because she mocked the servant of God.
